title: Calibrate and Practice Healthy Battery Charging
description: Configure charge limits to 80% on laptops and phones when used at a desk, preventing premature electrochemical degradation.

title: Clear Laptop Dust and Thermal Air Vents
description: Use compressed air to blow out dust accumulation from laptop heat pipes and fans to avoid thermal throttling and component fatigue.

title: Establish an Institutional Hardware Inventory Audit
description: Catalog all computers, monitors, and parts in storage rooms. Identify working systems suitable for student checkout programs.

title: Institute Standardized NIST SP 800-88 Data Sanitization
description: Implement verified cryptographic data wiping procedures on all retired corporate workstations before donation or recycling.

title: Clear the 'Junk Drawer' of Dormant Gadgets
description: Gather unused phones, tablets, and cables sitting in storage. Test operation and route them toward donation or certified e-waste drop-off.

title: Prioritize Repairable Hardware and Open Firmware
description: Choose devices with documented teardown guides, accessible screws, swappable SSDs/RAM, and community repair support.

title: Organize a Campus Electronics Take-Back & Donation Drive
description: Partner with local community learning centers to collect gently used laptops, wipe them safely, and supply underserved students.

title: Verify Certified Recycler Credentials Before Drop-off
description: Ensure e-waste processors hold recognized environmental certifications (such as R2v3 or e-Stewards) that prohibit illegal offshore dumping.
